observations: Clearest front-facing view is gsv_control_link_3_73051d258c (2020-10, station 1.0 m): one mast arm from a right-side pole spans the approach with four vehicle signal heads facing the camera; gsv_control_link_3_1c684f5e7f (2020-11, station -3.8 m) shows the same mast arm from farther back, with the heads small.

In 73051d258c, heads 1 and 2 (left and centre-left, about x 0.45-0.48 and 0.60-0.63) show red circular indications; head 3 (about x 0.75-0.79) shows a red right-turn arrow; head 4 (rightmost, about x 0.82-0.87) is unlit in this frame and its lens symbols cannot be read.

In 1c684f5e7f (a different phase), heads 1 and 2 show green indications (head 2 may be an upward arrow, unconfirmed at this resolution), head 3 again shows a red right arrow, and head 4 shows a green indication in its lower section whose shape (ball or arrow) is unresolved.

A small white rectangular regulatory sign is mounted on the mast arm between heads 3 and 4 (73051d258c about x 0.78-0.81, y 0.47-0.51). It has about three lines of black text that cannot be read at this resolution, so its content is not confirmed.

On the right mast pole near the camera in 73051d258c (about x 0.89-0.93, y 0.58-0.60) there is a lower pole-mounted head showing red; it could be a near-side vehicle head or a pedestrian signal, and its type is unresolved.

Beyond the crosswalk on the far-left median in 73051d258c (about x 0.39-0.41, y 0.68-0.70) there is a red circle-and-slash prohibitive turn sign facing the camera; which movement it prohibits (left or U-turn) cannot be read.
An orange temporary work-zone sign stands on the far right side beyond the intersection (73051d258c about x 0.64-0.66, y 0.68-0.70); its text is unreadable. A pink banner on a pole is decorative.
No stop sign is visible in either view. Signal lenses, arrows and sign text are all small, so lane assignment for the heads is not established from these images.

detail_requests.question: Read the text of the small white regulatory sign mounted on the mast arm between the third and fourth signal heads (for example a turn-on-red or lane-use restriction).

For the two right-hand signal heads, how many sections does each have, and what symbol is on each lens (circular ball, right arrow, other arrow)? Confirm that head 3's red indication is a right-turn arrow and identify head 4's unlit lens symbols.

In this green phase, what is the shape of each lit indication on the four mast-arm heads: circular ball or arrow, and if an arrow, which direction (through, right, left)? Note head 4's lit lower section.
Which movement does this red circle-and-slash sign on the far-left median prohibit (left turn, U-turn, other)? Is there a supplementary plaque, and does it face this approach?
